visualCharacteristics.purpose: Gift category tiles: product photo with a teal label bar, whole card linked
visualCharacteristics.description: White rounded (12px) card, product photo, teal (#329ab3) bar with white uppercase Roboto Condensed Bold label; 4 per row desktop, 2 per row mobile, 16px gap.

contentPattern.structure: one row per card, 2 cells (Image | Destination link; link text is the visible label)
contentPattern.description: Sixteen holiday gift category tiles (Ultimate Gifts, For Her, For Him, Stocking Stuffers ... For the Traveler)

usage.purpose: Linked gift category tiles with a visible label bar.

reuseGuidance: Use for photo tiles whose label is real text. Author one row per tile in visual order; the label is the link text.
